question: In which military exercise did India participate for the first time in 2025?
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Talisman Sabre**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India joins bilateral military exercise in Australia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
India has participated for the first time in **Exercise Talisman Sabre**, Australia’s largest bilateral military drill.

 
 
• 
 
The exercise was launched in **2005** as a **biennial** joint military exercise between the **United States and Australia**.

 
 
• 
 
In **2025**, it involves **over 35,000 personnel** from **19 countries**.

 
 
• 
 
Participating nations include: United States, Australia, India, Canada, Fiji, France, Germany, Indonesia, Japan, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Papua New Guinea, Philippines, South Korea, Singapore, Thailand, Tonga, and the United Kingdom.

 
 
• 
 
**Malaysia and Vietnam** are attending as **observers**.

 
 
• 
 
The exercise will be held over **three weeks**, covering joint operations across **land, sea, and air** domains.

 
 
• 
 
India’s participation marks a step forward in strengthening **Indo-Pacific defence ties** and interoperability.
